nginx rtmp
==========

## How to install nginx's rtmp module 
#### I used the detailed instruction of [www.vultr.com](https://www.vultr.com/docs/setup-nginx-rtmp-on-ubuntu-14-04)
1. sudo apt-get install build-essential libpcre3 libpcre3-dev libssl-dev
--> Die folgenden NEUEN Pakete werden installiert:
  _libpcre3-dev libpcre32-3 libpcrecpp0v5 libssl-dev libssl-doc zlib1g-dev_ . I want to delete them later, why do we need them?
2. mkdir ~/working
3. wget http://nginx.org/download/nginx-1.7.5.tar.gzcd ~/working
4. wget https://github.com/arut/nginx-rtmp-module/archive/master.zip
5. tar -zxvf nginx-1.7.5.tar.gz
6. unzip master.zip
7. _Now we really install nginx with it's module:_ 
8. ./configure --with-http_ssl_module --add-module=../nginx-rtmp-module-master

9. make
10. sudo make install
11. sudo wget https://raw.github.com/JasonGiedymin/nginx-init-ubuntu/master/nginx -O /etc/init.d/nginx
12. sudo chmod +x /etc/init.d/nginx
13. sudo update-rc.d nginx defaults

# How to start the stream

ffmpeg -f v4l2 -framerate 25 q -i /dev/video0 -vcodec libx264 -vb 1200k -strict -2 -ab 128k -ar 44100 -f flv rtmp://localhost:1935/live/trailer
